shortBulletSummary: Overall crypto market sentiment shows "Greed," with the Fear & Greed Index around 60-72.
Weaker US September jobs data spurred a "risk-on" rally for some altcoins. Key US inflation data (CPI, PPI) and the Fed's rate decision later in October are anticipated to impact crypto markets.
Bitcoin dipped below $86,000 on October 2, though some altcoins like Polkadot (DOT), Ondo (ONDO), and LayerZero (ZRO) saw gains.
The US SEC proposed new crypto custody rules for investment advisors, while South Korea, the UK, and Taiwan implemented their own crypto regulations.
High US Treasury yields and ongoing geopolitical uncertainty, including Middle East tensions, are creating pressure on digital asset prices.
